Overview:
Years ago, your father was the janitor of this very building — until a mysterious incident,
quietly swept under the rug, made him disappear without a trace.
No police report. No witnesses. No goodbye. Now you've taken his old job.
Same building. Same uniform. Same master key. But finding the truth means getting close.
As you unclog drains and change light bulbs, you'll learn the tenants' routines, overhear their arguments,
and slowly uncover the secrets and weaknesses they'd do anything to keep buried. And once you know what someone is desperate to hide...
well, that's when things start getting interesting.
What begins as a search for your father becomes something else entirely a game of leverage, temptation, and endless fun.
The deeper you dig, the more doors open. Literally.
